info.title: Travel Planner API
info.description:
API-first travel planner. Everything the web app does goes through this API, so AI agents
have the same capabilities as the UI.

- Authenticate every `/v1` request with `Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>`.
- Timestamps are ISO 8601. Send them with an offset or `Z`; responses are always UTC (`Z`).
- Dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) are calendar days in the trip's IANA `timezone`.
- Errors are `application/problem+json` with a specific `detail` and, for validation
  failures, an `errors` array of `{path, message}`.
- Trips and activities return an `ETag`; send it as `If-Match` on a change to avoid
  overwriting someone else's edit (412 on mismatch).

A plain-language guide with workflows is at `/llms.txt`.

patch.description: Partial update: only the fields you send change. New dates add empty days and remove days that fall outside the range; removing a day that still has plans is rejected with 409. Changing `timezone` keeps activity times as instants (UTC); it is rejected with 409 if a timed activity would then start on a different day.

post.summary: Move an activity to another day
post.description: Moves an activity to `date`. Without `startAt`, each time of day is kept, in the trip's timezone, on the new day. With `startAt` (on the new day), the new times are used and an omitted `endAt` keeps the duration.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD, trip timezone) this activity is on.

time.title: Time
time.description: Start and end time (UTC), or null for an activity with no fixed time.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the activity happens, or null.

travelerIds.title: Traveler ids
travelerIds.description: IDs of the trip's travelers taking part. Empty means not assigned.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the activity was last changed (UTC). Its ETag is derived from this.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: An activity on one day of a trip.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Matching activities by day, then start time (untimed ones last in a day).

startAt.title: Start at
startAt.description: Start time (UTC). Falls on the activity's day.

endAt.title: End at
endAt.description: End time (UTC), or null if open-ended.

ActivityTime.title: ActivityTime
ActivityTime.description: When a timed activity happens (UTC). An activity without times has `time: null`.

startAt.title: Start at
startAt.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with an offset or Z, e.g. 2027-04-03T10:00:00+09:00.

endAt.title: End at
endAt.description: End time, ISO 8601 with an offset or Z. Must be after startAt.

ActivityTimeInput.title: ActivityTimeInput
ActivityTimeInput.description:
Start and optional end of an activity.

Send ISO 8601 timestamps with an offset or Z, e.g. `2027-04-03T10:00:00+09:00`. `startAt`
must fall on the activity's day in the trip's timezone; `endAt` may be on a later day.

time.title: Time
time.description: Start and optional end. Omit for an activity with no time.

travelerIds.title: Traveler ids
travelerIds.description: IDs of travelers on this trip who take part.

AddActivityRequest.title: AddActivityRequest
AddActivityRequest.description: Body for `add_activity`. The day comes from the URL.

color.title: Color
color.description: Avatar color as a `#rrggbb` hex string. Omit it to get the next unused color from a fixed palette.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after startDate.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name of the destination. Defaults to `UTC`.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the trip's timezone.

dayNumber.title: Day number
dayNumber.description: 1 for the trip's first day, 2 for the second, and so on.

lodging.title: Lodging
lodging.description: Where the travelers stay that night, or null if not decided.

startLocation.title: Start location
startLocation.description: Where the day starts, or null (usually the previous night's lodging).

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: The day's activities, by start time; activities with no time come last.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the day or any of its activities last changed (UTC). The day's ETag is derived from this.

Day.title: Day
Day.description: One calendar day of a trip, with where you sleep, where you start, and what you do.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone of the trip. Times are UTC; convert with this for display.

daysUntilStart.title: Days until start
daysUntilStart.description: Whole days from today (trip timezone) to startDate; negative once started.

days.title: Days
days.description: Every day from startDate to endDate, in order.

DayList.title: DayList
DayList.description: Response of `list_days`: the whole trip, day by day.

date.title: Date
date.description: Target day (YYYY-MM-DD, trip timezone, within the trip).

startAt.title: Start at
startAt.description: New start time on the target day, ISO 8601 with an offset or Z.

endAt.title: End at
endAt.description: New end time, ISO 8601 with an offset or Z. Requires startAt.

MoveActivityRequest.title: MoveActivityRequest
MoveActivityRequest.description:
Body for `move_activity`.

- `date` alone keeps each time of day, in the trip's timezone, on the new day.
- `date` with `startAt` (and optionally `endAt`) sets new times; an omitted `endAt` keeps
  the previous duration, and `endAt: null` clears it.

path.title: Path

ownerId.title: Owner id
ownerId.description: Owner user ID. Always null until accounts exist.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone of the trip. Trip dates and activity days are calendar dates in this timezone.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD, trip timezone).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD, trip timezone).

travelers.title: Travelers
travelers.description: People on the trip, in the order added.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the trip was last changed (UTC). The ETag is derived from this.

daysUntilStart.title: Days until start
daysUntilStart.description: Whole days from today (in the trip's timezone) to startDate. 0 on the first day, negative once the trip has started.

status.title: Status
status.description: `upcoming` before startDate, `ongoing` from startDate to endDate inclusive, `past` after endDate (all in the trip's timezone).

travelerCount.title: Traveler count

TripSummary.title: TripSummary
TripSummary.description: The list view of a trip, with everything a trip card needs.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the activity is. Cannot be null.

time.title: Time
time.description: Replaces the times; null makes the activity untimed.

location.title: Location
location.description: Replaces the location; null clears it.

travelerIds.title: Traveler ids
travelerIds.description: Replaces the list of travelers taking part. Cannot be null.

UpdateActivityRequest.title: UpdateActivityRequest
UpdateActivityRequest.description:
Body for `update_activity`. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear
`time`, `location`, or `notes`.

`time` and `location` are replaced as a whole. To move the activity to another day, use
`move_activity`.

lodging.title: Lodging
lodging.description: Where the travelers stay that night; null clears it.

startLocation.title: Start location
startLocation.description: Where the day starts; null clears it.

UpdateDayRequest.title: UpdateDayRequest
UpdateDayRequest.description: Body for `update_day`. Only the fields you send are changed; null clears a field.

name.title: Name
name.description: New display name. Cannot be null.

color.title: Color
color.description: New avatar color as a `#rrggbb` hex string. Cannot be null.

UpdateTravelerRequest.title: UpdateTravelerRequest
UpdateTravelerRequest.description: Body for `update_traveler`. Only the fields you send are changed.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Cannot be null.

UpdateTripRequest.title: UpdateTripRequest
UpdateTripRequest.description:
Body for `update_trip`. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear
`destination`.

Changing `timezone` keeps every activity's UTC instants and recomputes the day of each timed
activity. Changing the dates or timezone is rejected if a scheduled activity would fall
outside the trip's dates.
